rationale: B is the stronger service catalogue because it is more commercially actionable and consistently structured: each offering has a service code, defined scope, concrete deliverables, duration, and engagement model, while the portfolio clearly balances audits, roadmaps, and advisory work across M365 and adjacent platforms. Its maturity assessments, decision records, TCO models, success metrics, and phased programmes make the services easier to scope and buy. A is strong and somewhat more explicit about emerging technologies, but it is less consistent at the individual-service level and includes a few questionable or dated product references. B also has minor terminology issues, such as the outdated Power Virtual Agents name and a typo in “centre-of-excellence,” but these do not outweigh its clearer catalogue design and stronger actionability.
